1445-4871-5231-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5231-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2111-2292-6792.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

654-851-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

81-855-2021-2060.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5101-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {3}{G}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5101-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Merfolk Skydiver by paying {3}{G}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
1833-3967-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

618-4456-6573-7494.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone this game.
618-4456-6573-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R} due to Font of Magic.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
618-4456-6573-7494.notes: If you've cast a commander two or more times from the command zone this game, the starting cost is reduced by {1} and you'll net infinite red mana.

628-5007-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
628-5007-5231.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

433-907-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
433-907-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1879-2366-5175-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1879-2366-5175-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2921-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

1110-3197-6919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
1110-3197-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Herd Baloth.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1661-2033-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-4045.description:
Activate Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Ur-Golem's Eye.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Ur-Golem's Eye.
Repeat.

1987-4423-5116-6650.easyPrerequisites:
You control three additional Islands.
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1987-4423-5116-6650.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus by tapping them, adding {3}{U}
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

252-2073-3698--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
When the artifact enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

2882-5147-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2882-5147-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2882-5147-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

190-831-6527.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 11 or higher.
190-831-6527.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Delusions of Mediocrity and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Each opponent's Delusions of Mediocrity's first ability triggers, and your Delusions of Mediocrity's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to gain 10 life and you to lose 10 life.
Cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Each opponent's Delusions of Mediocrity's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 10 life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.n: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom

111-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have a way to defeat Invasion of Alara.
111-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Defeat Invasion of Alara, causing you to cast Awaken the Maelstrom without paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
111-1617-4831-4983-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

372-3306-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3306-5913.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2281-2438-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2489-3341-5607.notablePrerequisites:
Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness.
Klauth and Charnelhoard Wurm cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2489-3341-5607.description:
Declare Charnelhoard Wurm and Klauth as attackers.
Klauth triggers, adding at least {8}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

803-3168-3859-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Arcane Adaptation.
803-3168-3859-5613.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {0}.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-3605-5145.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

273-3652-4763-5147.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Koll triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1409-1414-3430-5131.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Muldrotha.
1409-1414-3430-5131.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Muldrotha by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Muldrotha enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Muldrotha.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-3046-3902.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Overgrown Armasaur indestructible.
2034-3046-3902.description:
Give Overgrown Armasaur indestructible, if needed.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Overgrown Armasaur.
Overgrown Armasaur triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Halana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Overgrown Armasaur.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-2959-4147-4294.notablePrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.Primal Conquerer.
It is your precombat main phase.
2178-2959-4147-4294.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Etali with haste.
Choose to put the nontoken Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
The Etali token and Hua Tuo trigger.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger untapping it.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali token's trigger from step 4, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Choose to put the nontoken Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
The nontoken Etali and Hua Tuo trigger.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger untapping it.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Etali's trigger from step 10, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 8.

1218-2390-5299.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
1218-2390-5299.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving All Will Be One +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat step 3.

523-3263-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents are unable to block and kill creatures you control.
There are at least twenty permanents on the battlefield.
Hellkite Tyrant does not have summoning sickness.
523-3263-4711.description:
Declare Hellkite Tyrant as an attacker.
Hellkite Tyrant's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of it attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with each Hellkite Tyrant.
Each Hellkite Tyrant's ability triggers, causing you to gain control of all permanents your opponent control, as they are all artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Hellkite Tyrant triggers, causing you to win the game.

3054-3416-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-3416-4050.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Vampire token and Oathsworn Vampire, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

4050-4518-4812-5043.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}, targeting Kor Skyfisher.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Resolve Animate Dead, returning Kor Skyfisher from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from the battlefield to your hand.
Animate Dead leaves the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher and the Faerie token, adding {1}{B}.
Resolve the Animate Dead trigger, causing you to not sacrifice Kor Skyfisher due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

813-2564-4231-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1328-3750-4276.notablePrerequisites:
Spellbinder attached to a creature that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
The creature with Spellbinder attached can attack this turn.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
1328-3750-4276.description:
Deal combat damage with the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, casting a copy of Turnabout without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Turnabout, untapping all tapped lands you control.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an addtional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1339-1926-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Insect.
"Insect" chosen with Species Specialist.
1339-1926-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding one mana of any color.
The Insect dies, triggering Species Specialist, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

2034-2308-3188.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-3188.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

741-4944.description:
Activate Hopping Automaton's ability.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
With the ability on the stack, repeat.

1329-3338-3652-3698.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3338-3652-3698.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.
